verdict.rationale: Tavily Search documents a `language` parameter that accepts ISO 639-1 codes or English language names. It boosts results in that language rather than strictly filtering them, so this is one first-party localization lever. The evidence pack contains no country, region, or geographic-location parameter, so only the language dimension of the story is covered. Missing for 10: a country/region or location parameter, strict language filtering (not just boosting), and independent or hands-on corroboration of localization quality.
